reasoning_content:
Daemon running as qisutu. Now let me verify the REST API and maybe the static assets. Also run relevant installer tests? The guide's verification is the web installer completion. Let me also run the install-related Perl tests that don't need DB? Actually the repo has tests. But those test the source, not installation. I could run them to demonstrate, but not required.

Let me confirm the daemon stays running and the API endpoint responds. Also verify instance.conf and config. Let's consolidate final verification.

Let me check REST API endpoint (api.pl) requires auth. And check index.pl serves properly. Already did login.

Let me also verify that a fresh re-run of install.sh detects the completed install (should say already installed and exit 1). That confirms installed.lock. Not needed.

Let me gather final evidence.

Also I should double-check the permissions ownership expected: /opt/qisutu owned qisutu:www-data.

action.command:
echo "=== ownership"; stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /opt/qisutu /opt/qisutu/var/log /opt/qisutu/var/secure /opt/qisutu/var/secure/security.key /opt/qisutu/core/config/QisutuConfig.pm /opt/qisutu/var/install/instance.conf
echo "=== instance.conf"; cat /opt/qisutu/var/install/instance.conf
echo "=== db tables"; mariadb -uroot qisutu -e "SELECT COUNT(*) AS tables_count FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='qisutu';"
echo "=== daemon still alive"; pgrep -af "qisutu-daemon.pl" | grep -v pgrep | grep perl
echo "=== api"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost/qisutu/api.pl
echo "=== index"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl
